name: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP)
status: Specification and sample code published by Visa under Visa Product Terms of 2025-10-10; the product page says "This product is in the process of development and deployment."
relevance: The merchant specification says "this protocol is applicable to the scenario when the Agent is initially unknown to the Merchant." It defines three signatures: an agent recognition signature based on HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421) and aligned with web-bot-auth, a signed consumer or device identity and a signed payment container. A merchant or its site protection provider verifies them; the sample repository calls the protocol "a standardized, cryptographic method for an AI agent to prove its identity and associated authorization directly to merchants."
boundary: "Merchants are not required to use this proposal and do not necessarily have to be registered with the Payment Schemes".
